execution_policy_review.decision: Explicit analytical policies, not measured hardware behavior. CMEM starts cold with full-K A/B panels for at most cmem_groups_mn VMEM output blocks. Preserve the selected panel shape; use two slots only when capacity and remaining panels allow, otherwise one. Capacity and bandwidth are equally partitioned between TensorCores with no borrowing. If one panel does not fit, shrink groups, then report bypass if necessary. Resource-pipeline scheduling overlaps next-panel fills with inner execution and releases CMEM slots after their last input read. HBM fills and exports share one non-preemptive service; late refills are deferred until after the current output export. CMEM read and write services are independent across different live slots. Each DMA reserves both endpoints once at the minimum rate plus transfer_startup. Serial mode disables overlap. VMEM retains C across K with one or two input slots; inner output blocks remain serial. No partial-fill consumption, cross-outer/task retention, OCI/bank conflicts, physical layout or XLA mapping. CLI/API overrides, effective mode and slot counts are reported.
